name: Suspend
author: João Magalhães
description: Suspends the machine after a period of idle, set from a bar widget with presets or a typed duration. Honours Stay Awake, Wayland idle inhibitors, systemd sleep inhibitors and Omarchy's suspend toggle.

barWidget.description: Sleep after 15 min, 30 min, 1 h, 3 h, never, or any duration you type.

schema.label: Seconds of idle before suspending (0 = never)
Show the timeout next to the icon
